title: Proxy-Based Approximation of Shapley and Banzhaf Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2605.22738v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Shapley and Banzhaf interactions capture the complex dynamics inherent in modern machine learning applications. However, current estimators for these higher-order interactions trade off between speed and accuracy. To overcome this limitation, we introduce ProxySHAP. ProxySHAP reconciles the high sample efficiency of tree-based proxy models with a situational residual correction recovering consistency. On a theoretical level, we derive a polynomial-time generalization of interventional TreeSHAP that computes exact interaction indices for tree ensembles, thereby bypassing exponential tree-depth dependencies in prior methods. Furthermore, we formally analyze the residual adjustment strategy, characterizing the specific conditions under which Maximum Sample Reuse (MSR) corrects proxy bias without its variance scaling exponentially with interaction size. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates that ProxySHAP sets a new state-of-the-art

translated_title: 基于代理模型的Shapley与Banzhaf交互作用近似
translated_abstract: Shapley与Banzhaf交互作用能够刻画现代机器学习应用中固有的复杂动态。然而，现有的高阶交互作用估计器在速度与精度之间难以兼顾。为克服这一局限，我们提出了ProxySHAP。ProxySHAP将基于树的代理模型的高样本效率与情景残差校正相结合，从而恢复一致性。在理论层面，我们推导出了干预式TreeSHAP的多项式时间泛化方法，可为树集成模型计算精确的交互作用指数，从而规避了以往方法中指数级树深度的依赖。此外，我们对残差调整策略进行了正式分析，刻画了最大样本复用在何种具体条件下能够校正代理偏差，同时其方差不会随交互作用规模呈指数级增长。大量基准测试表明，ProxySHAP树立了新的最先进水平。
tldr: ProxySHAP将树代理模型的高样本效率与情景残差校正相结合，实现了Shapley与Banzhaf交互作用估计在速度与精度上的兼得，并首次提出多项式时间的树集成精确交互指数计算方法。
en_tdlr: ProxySHAP reconciles the sample efficiency of tree-based proxy models with residual correction to achieve both speed and accuracy in estimating Shapley and Banzhaf interactions, introducing a polynomial-time exact computation of interaction indices for tree ensembles.
